content: MR.PLUS Pressure Cookers come with a 2-year manufacturer warranty covering manufacturing defects, valve assembly, and gasket seating.
MR.PLUS Non-Stick Appachatty, Frypans, and Tawa carry a 1-year warranty against coating peeling under normal domestic usage.
MR.PLUS Soundbars and Bluetooth Speakers carry a 1-year doorstep warranty for audio circuits and power supplies.
